test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence. **

You have asked Varun why he feels this is important for him.

options.text: You ask Varun, “Why do you feel that is important to you?”
You have asked Varun, “Why do you feel this is important for you?”
You asked Varun, “Why do you feel this is important for him?”
You have asked Varun, “Why you feel this is important to you?”

solution:
The correct answer is: **You have asked Varun, “Why do you feel this is important for you?” **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech** and we need to convert it to **direct speech.**
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these **rules**:
 
 
• The reporting verb '**asked**' remains unchanged.
 
• The conjunction '**that**' is replaced with **inverted commas ("...") **to show the direct speech part.
 
• A **comma (,) **is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The **first **word of the direct speech is in **capital **letter.
 
• The pronoun '**you**' changes to '**him**'.
 
 

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

**Hence, direct speech is -** *You have asked Varun, “Why do you feel this is important for you?” *
